column1: # Single source of truth for everything Argo CD deploys (spec k8s-gitops-cicd, task 6).
#   scripts/gen-argocd-apps.py  -> deploy/argocd/apps/*.yaml (Argo CD Applications; CI checks they are up to date)
#   scripts/cluster-up.sh       -> --mode=direct installs exactly these versions/values with helm / kubectl
#   name  namespace  wave  type  source  ref  path_or_chart  values  options
#   type helm: source = chart repo URL, ref = chart version, path_or_chart = chart name, values = file in deploy/platform/values
#   type git : source = git repo URL (or "self" = this repo), ref = tag/branch, path_or_chart = directory
#   options: comma list - ssa (server-side apply and server-side diff), noprune, noselfheal, manual,
#            nofinalizer (deleting the Application must not delete what it runs - Argo CD itself)
